kitchen.intro: The motion kit and the Lottie budget. Everything is subtle, purposeful and switches off with reduced motion.
kitchen.interactionHint: Hover lift, press squeeze and a sliding selection pill.
kitchen.collapseBody: Collapse animates height automatically and unmounts its content once closed.
kitchen.lottieHint: {count} hand-made files, re-coloured from the theme tokens at runtime.
kitchen.emptyBody: Every lead has an owner who acknowledged it. Nice work.
kitchen.handoffBody: The AI stand-in passes the conversation to the lead owner.
kitchen.reduced: Reduced motion: turn it on in your OS to see the still versions.
